body: Why is the request being serialized? Is the error handler in the middle of serializing the stack trace?

So yes - it is serializing a stack trace. Stack trace serialization has been removed in master because it causes problems with error response generation. Could you check `dev-master` and see if your problem is resolved?
Sounds like sth similar to https://github.com/cakephp/cakephp/pull/8131 - so should be resolved indeed.

:+1: @markstory that fixed it.

Will that be in 3.2.3?

❤

The same error still appears in 3.2.3.
Going HTTP GET on .json triggers a login dialog, on .xml triggers `Warning (4096): Object of class Cake\Network\Request could not be converted to string [CORE/src/Utility/Xml.php, line 338]` etc (see above).
@ionas Are you still getting a stack trace in your exception responses?

Ok. The trace output was supposed to have been removed in 3.2.2, but has snuck its way back in. As the current master branch shows the trace still being serialized. Looks like the changes in #8131 never found their way onto master. I'll get that fixed.
